thread:
Elena: hi team — quick Q. Im trying to add my daughter (on F-2) as a dependent. school just issued her I-20 and we have visa stamp, but shes currently living with my sister for a month while we finalize housing. Carrier asked for proof of US residence for dependents — can a temporary lease or a notarized letter + school enrollment letter work? Im aiming for coverage starting 08/01.

Priya: hey @Elena  congrats. For international student dependents we typically accept: 1) copy of I-20; 2) visa stamp/passport; 3) proof of US address — acceptable items: current lease with dependent name, recent utility bill, or a school enrollment letter that includes the address. If dependent is temporarily at a different household, a notarized letter from the host plus a copy of the hosts lease + recent utility bill can be used provisionally.

Elena: perfect. I have the I-20 and passport scan. my current lease wont be finalized until 7/25, so i can provide a notarized letter from my sister and her lease + utility bill. Will that let us enroll for 08/01? Also worried about when the carrier needs an SSN/ITIN — we dont have that for the child yet.

Jordan: that should be fine to start the QLE enrollment provisionally. Carrier enrollment often requires SSN/ITIN for dependents eventually; however we can enroll provisionally using "pending tax ID" and update the carrier once you have the SSN/ITIN. Some carriers request the number at onboarding; if they refuse provisional, benefits will work with the carrier to allow enrollment with follow-up. Please plan to upload SSN/ITIN within 60 days of enrollment if possible.

Elena: thanks. Payroll question: Im expecting the premium to start 08/01. If we enroll late in July and it hits payroll, can we split the first-month deduction?

Priya: yes — if the retro period is short (a few days) we typically prorate the first deduction. If you prefer splitting the deduction across pay cycles, request a split via the portal when you upload docs. benefits-bot (below) has file naming.

benefits-bot: Reminder: Upload documents in the People Ops secure portal. Suggested filename format: dependent_docs/<lastname>_child_<doctype>_<yyyymmdd>.pdf (e.g. dependent_docs/Nguyen_child_i20_passport_20240720.pdf). Reply "uploaded" after you add files. For split deductions, include "split-2" or "split-3" in your upload note.

Elena: uploaded dependent_docs/Sanchez_child_i20_passport_notarizedhost_20240718.pdf and host_lease_20240718.pdf. I added "split-2" in notes. Daughter name: Sofia Maria Sanchez, DOB 2023-11-02.

Priya: got it. Well start the QLE and request coverage effective 2024-08-01. Benefits will confirm carrier onboarding within 2 business days; payroll will honor split-2 request if submitted before cutoff. Please update here once you have SSN/ITIN so we can push to carrier. Closing loop shortly. :white_check_mark:
